nodes.title: Note 2
widgets_values:
Turbo LoRA = fewer sampling steps.
Spectrum / Cache = skip repeated computation inside a step.
Together these are what make 8 steps viable.

nodes.title: Note 3
widgets_values:
guard_threshold
0.25 lets the model guess when a block changes: more skips, but it can guess away a face or a detail.
Lower it (0.10-0.15) for portraits and garments; raise it for backgrounds.
